cases.name: stress_300_full_alphabet
cases.code:
import random
rnd = random.Random(61)
s = ''.join(chr(rnd.randint(33, 126)) for _ in range(300))
result = [sol.min_insertions(s, [chr(i) for i in range(32, 127)]), sol.min_insertions(s, s[:150])]
